claims.statement: CommandFetcher makes temporary real Git checkout, resolves HEAD and returns scoped cleanup.
limitations: Branch is mutable; URL validation does not certify all private Git authentication configurations.

claims.statement: Sync applies sorted manifest files sequentially through parser/ApplyService; later failure does not roll back earlier applies.
limitations: LastRevision updates only after successful loop/prune; not atomic repository-wide provenance.

claims.statement: Actual local Atlas fixture kept manual scale under warn and restored desired zero under status-triggered auto_revert.
limitations: MemoryService state only; restoration does not freshly call Admit/quota; no independently asserted continuous drift loop.

claims.statement: Actual fixture pruned previously managed Atlas name and preserved unrelated name; baseline prune predicates on previous/wanted names.
limitations: No current object-ID/source-ID ownership comparison; replacement/transfer same-name risk remains untested and disclosed.
